title: Feature lifecycle
summary: The stages a feature moves through, from raw material to delivery and back (D-148 to D-152). Each workflow names the stage it serves in its routing block, so a new workflow appears under its stage without anything here changing. Stages are tags, not gates: they can be skipped, entered at any point or repeated. Moves that work at every stage, such as review and decide, name the stage "any".

stages.title: Discover
stages.question: What problems do people actually have, and what did we learn from what shipped?

stages.title: Shape
stages.question: What do we intend to do about it, and is it ready to commit to?

stages.title: Requirements
stages.question: What exactly are we building, what does it depend on, and which way do we take?

stages.title: Engage
stages.question: Are the teams we rely on on board, and how far along is each?

stages.title: Deliver
stages.question: Will it land when we said, and what moved?
